metadata.purpose: Share one live source connection among subscribers using a Subject and explicit boolean reset policies.

conditions: Shared is project teaching notation for a connection/ownership policy, not original Cω syntax.
A subscriber observes a subsequence determined by its connection interval, not a replay of all source values.
Broadcasts are addressed to subscriptions. Total addressed deliveries may exceed the number of source values.

scope.parameters: Subject connector with boolean resetOnError=true, resetOnComplete=true, resetOnRefCountZero=true
scope.callbacks: No custom connector or reset-notifier functions. Observer/source/finalizer activity is non-reentrant and nonthrowing.
scope.time: No timer or clock is introduced. Ordered source and subscriber events determine membership at each delivery.
scope.reentrancy: Atomic post-setup reactions. Each subscriber ID denotes one subscription occurrence and must not be reused.
exclusions: Custom SubjectLike connectors, replay and notifier-driven delayed resets.
Reentrant joins/leaves during notification, source setup or teardown; throwing observers/finalizers.
Physical producer abortion, lossless snapshots and a production shared-effect interpreter.

initialization.sourceSubscription: Only the first live subscriber acquires a connection; later subscribers join it.

ownership.sharing: One machine per shared Observable instance, not per subscriber. Each reset creates a fresh connection generation.
ownership.reset: Boolean policies reset after error, completion or last live departure. Retained terminal subjects still accept late subscription events.

resources.owner: shared Observable; connection generation distinguishes reconnects

dispatch.actionSemantics: Commit registry/reset state before delivering addressed notifications; observe source release after terminal delivery under post-setup execution. IDs are unique subscription occurrences, not reusable observer names.
cancellationCheckpoints: A leave affects one subscriber. Only a last leave with reset enabled disconnects the source.
Source termination ends existing subscriptions; resetting is not retrying those subscribers.

inputs.description: the current connection delivers a value

controls.description: one live source; zero or more observers according to reset policy

rules.guard: fresh subscription ID and available connection generation
actions: subscribe to the source under a fresh connection generation
rules.nextState: one registered subscriber and one connection
rules.explanation: Constructing the shared Observable starts nothing. Its first subscriber creates a Subject-backed connection to the source; that connection is shared by overlapping subscribers.

rules.nextState: append subscriber to the existing connection, without replay
rules.explanation: A subscriber joining a live connection receives future values, not past values. It does not create another source subscription. Sharing is not replay.

actions: forward the value to each currently registered subscriber in registration order
rules.explanation: A source value is forwarded unchanged to each currently subscribed observer. With no observers, a retained connection can still receive values, but share stores none of them.

rules.guard: registered subscriber and at least one other remains
rules.explanation: When one subscriber leaves while others remain, remove only that subscriber. The shared source continues and no completion is sent to the departing observer.

rules.guard: the last registered subscriber leaves; resetOnRefCountZero=true
rules.nextState: reset the connection with no live subscribers
rules.explanation: When the last subscriber leaves a nonterminated connection, resetOnRefCountZero=true disconnects and resets it. A future subscriber starts a new source execution. No completion notification is synthesized.

actions: send complete to each current subscriber
rules.nextState: reset for a later fresh subscription
rules.explanation: On source complete, notify current subscribers and release that source connection. The configured reset permits a future subscriber to start fresh; it does not retry the terminated subscriptions.

actions: send error to each current subscriber
rules.nextState: reset for a later fresh subscription
rules.explanation: On source error, notify current subscribers and release that source connection. The configured reset permits a future subscriber to start fresh; it does not retry the terminated subscriptions.
